messages:
sana (Sales Eng): Heads up team — OrbitPartner wants a joint pilot next week. Key asks: SSO (SAML), EU-only routing, and an initial cost estimate for a shared co-sell tenant. Any immediate blockers?
oliver (OrbitPartner): Thanks, Sana. Legal also requested completed security questionnaire + SOC/pen-test summary. We need the questionnaire back by Fri COB.
ana (Solutions): We can run them on a shared tenant with strict tenant isolation. Will need to confirm model variant (some models have export restrictions in region).
diego (Infra): For EU-only routing we can set a regional selector to eu-central-1. If they need static outbound IPs for firewall rules we can provide a small set. Do they need inbound IP allowlist for webhooks?
oliver (OrbitPartner): Not inbound webhooks for the pilot. Outbound static IPs yes. Also: will logs be retained in their region? They prefer EU-only logging for compliance.
lee (Security): We require completed questionnaire to state: encryption at rest (AES-256), TLS1.2+, key management (KMS/HSM), and tenant volume separation. Also contact for IR and cert chain with expiry dates.
sana (Sales Eng): Oliver 14 14 could you share anticipated QPS and example prompt/response sizes so we can refine the cost?
oliver (OrbitPartner): Expected traffic: steady ~300 reqs/min, bursts to 900. Demo prompts ~80 tokens, responses ~220 tokens avg.
diego (Infra): Provisional egress IPs for EU sandbox (subject to change):
```
52.47.88.101/32
52.47.88.102/32
52.47.88.103/32
```
I'll confirm once tenant is provisioned.
provision-bot: orbit-sandbox-provisioner: provisioning started for orbit-partner-2146001234. ETA ~2h.
lee (Security): Also need pen-test cadence and last test date. I'll draft the questionnaire answers we can share and tag legal for export-control on model weights.
ana (Solutions): For cost, rough config suggestion: 2x T4-equivalent shared workers + autoscale to 3 for bursts, plus KV prefix caching. Back-of-envelope monthly range: €4k-7k depending on token volume and egress. Sana will formalize.
sana (Sales Eng): I'll run a token-based cost calc and send a short quote by EOD. Quick question: will Orbit want SIEM forwarding during pilot? That changes egress and retention.
oliver (OrbitPartner): Not for pilot. We'll enable SIEM forwarding later. For now audit logs via Console UI is fine.
diego (Infra): Action items: (1) I'll post final egress IPs and tenant ETA. (2) Oliver to upload SAML metadata and completed questionnaire. (3) Sana to send refined quote after token calc.
provision-bot: orbit-sandbox-provisioner: sandbox ready -> https://sandbox.redwood-inference.com/pilot/orbit-partner-2146001234 (creds sent via DM) :white_check_mark:
lee (Security): I'll attach cert summary and contact info to the questionnaire draft. Legal, please confirm export-control line when available.
oliver (OrbitPartner): Will upload SAML metadata and questionnaire by this afternoon. Thanks everyone.
sana (Sales Eng): Great. I'll follow up with a 1-page runbook (canary steps + rollback path) and a price breakdown. Ping here if anything blocks.
